March 7, 1968 
Bulletin #8 


R_E C A P - 3RD REPORT LUNCHEON 


An additional $41,000 reported - an increase of 
12% on our overall objective. 

Total to Date - $165,156 or 18.6% on our 
objective of $30,000. 

St. Andrews Division - Jeff Aimers, Chairman, 
had l2 of their key workers out for lunch. They 
also reported 57% of their objective. Second 
only to - 

Verdun-LaSalle who reported 88% . 
International, Lachine-Dorval and West Island 
were the big gainers last week showing gains of 
15%, 14%, anc 1% respectively. 


of us feel very optimistic about achieving 
our Campaign objective.

THE NEXT 


WEDN'USDAY , MARCH 13, 1968 


PLEASE NOTE 

- This date will be used for a meeting of 
Divisional Chairmen and the Campaign 
leadership team. 

~- It will be a working meeting where we 
will review where we stand in all 
Divisions - and assess our position. 

- A report on Progress to date by Division 
will be received - we hope for at least 
a 20% gain over last week. 

- We will meet for lunch in the Board Room 
at 12:30 Noon. 


Keys to a successful campaign - per Pavl Zimmerman 
"Have a distinguished and able vice-chairman like 
Paul Cote; prepare now for effective follow up: 
make more new contacts: call back some key cards 
for re-issue: and the objective is obtainable." 


10% NET NEW MONTY PER DIVISION IS ALL WE NEED 


"Dividends On Your Dollars" - Mac Singleton, 
Executive Secretary, NDG Branch shared with us 
the tangible benefits of money invested in the 
YMCA at our Luncheon meeting. 

Development of skills, engagement with youth (not 
work with youth), communication and the right for 
youth to question and explore were some of the 
highlights "Mac" dealt with in his talk.
